concerns.text: FR-004 states that if the CLMM fails to converge the system must switch to a robust alternative such as an LMM with robust SEs or a non‑parametric bootstrap, while FR-005 requires using a Wilcoxon signed‑rank test (with Bonferroni correction) as the fallback. The two fallback methods are mutually exclusive, creating a contradictory requirement for the same failure condition.

Multiple functional requirements (e.g., FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, FR-008) contain cross‑references to "US-001", "US-002", and "US-003", but no user‑story identifiers with those names exist in the document; user stories are labeled "User Story 1", "User Story 2", etc. These undefined references break traceability.

The document mixes terminology: user stories are introduced as "User Story 1" etc., yet later requirements refer to them via "US-001" style IDs. This inconsistency can cause confusion and makes the cross‑references above invalid.

The specification cites the CLIP‑Microscope dataset (neuronal microscopy images) as the source of base images, which does not contain human‑centric, socially relevant scenes required for a moral‑judgment experiment. This violates FR‑001 and FR‑008, rendering the stimulus set inappropriate for the research question.

The power analysis script assumes a generic effect size (β≈0.5) and a minimum N ≥ 60 without justifying why a medium effect is plausible, nor specifying the number of scenarios, participants per scenario, or the expected intra‑class correlation. Missing variance‑component assumptions for the CLMM may lead to under‑powered studies and increased Type II error risk.

responses.response: Aligned fallback analysis methods: both FR-004 and FR-005 now specify the same robust alternative (LMM with bootstrap) when the CLMM fails to converge, removing the contradictory Wilcoxon fallback.
responses.what_changed: Rewrote FR-004 and FR-005 text to reference a single fallback method (robust LMM with bootstrap) and removed Wilcoxon mention.

responses.response: Created explicit User Story identifiers US-001, US-002, US-003 and updated all cross‑references in functional requirements to these IDs.
responses.what_changed: Prefixed each User Story title with its US‑XXX ID and replaced undefined US‑001/US‑002/US‑003 references in FR‑001…FR‑008 with the new IDs.

responses.response: Standardized terminology by using the US‑XXX identifier format throughout the document for user stories and requirements.
responses.what_changed: Renamed user stories to include US‑XXX IDs and ensured all mentions use this notation.

responses.response: Replaced the erroneous CLIP‑Microscope dataset reference with the appropriate Visual Genome dataset throughout the specification.
responses.what_changed: Edited FR‑001 description and removed any mention of CLIP‑Microscope; clarified that source images come from Visual Genome.

responses.response: Added explicit power‑analysis assumptions (effect size odds ratio 1.5, 20 scenarios, 30 participants per scenario, ICCs 0.10 participant, 0.05 scenario) and a new functional requirement FR‑009 that mandates an a‑priori power analysis targeting 80 % power.
responses.what_changed: Inserted detailed power‑analysis justification in Assumptions and added FR‑009 describing the required analysis and reporting.
